name: Pushyamitra Shunga
contribution: The founder and the first ruler of the Shunga Empire which he established to succeed the Maurya Empire.
image_credit: Leiden University Library / Royal Netherlands Institute of Southeast Asian and Caribbean Studies · Public domain

checks.lead: Pushyamitra Shunga (IAST: Puṣyamitra Śuṅga; reigned c. 185 – c. 149 BCE), also known as Pushpamitra Shunga (IAST: Puṣpamitra Śuṅga) was the founder and the first ruler of the Shunga Empire which he established to succeed the Maurya Empire.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
